title: History & Philosophy
seo_title: About Quest Watersports | Ottawa, IL Since 1992
seo_description: From Riverview Marine in 1992 to Illinois's first boat club in 2011, see how Quest Watersports grew into Ottawa's boat, kayak and eBike destination.
body_html:
There is something magical about being on the water. It relaxes, brings friends and family together, stirs up fun and creates memories. Water reminds us that life is an adventure.

At Quest Watersports we live, work and play on the water, and we are here to help you do the same. We make boating simple and carefree, and bring the latest in water-based experiences to the heart of Starved Rock Country. Let us help you discover, re-discover or make the most of your watersports lifestyle.

Our history

1992: Riverview Marine

Our original location, Riverview Marine, opened in Spring Valley, Illinois in 1992 and was recognized as the Midwest's preferred dealer serving all types of boaters, from fishermen to high-performance enthusiasts.

2009: Ottawa and a new name

We relocated to Ottawa, upgraded to a larger facility and aligned closely with Heritage Harbor Marina. We also adopted a new name, Quest Watersports, to reflect our growth and vision. Quest offers large and small vessels to discerning recreational boaters, along with a complete set of boating-related services, conveniently near Heritage Harbor Ottawa, the most exciting marina resort community in the Midwest.

2011: Quest Express Boat Club and Hobie kayaks

We launched Quest Express Boat Club, the first such program in Illinois. It gives members unlimited access to a fleet of club boats on an annual membership, with no need to buy, maintain, transport, store or insure a boat. The same year we expanded into paddlesports with Hobie kayaks and their MirageDrive pedaling system, plus a premium paddlesports rental program.

2012 and beyond: paddleboards, Hobie Eclipse and eBikes

In 2012 we added stand-up paddleboards and expanded our paddlesports rentals. In 2016 the Hobie Eclipse joined the lineup, bringing pedal-driven agility to the walk-on-water sensation of a surfboard. Today we also offer electric bikes and eBike rentals for exploring the I&M Canal Trail.

What is next

Keep an eye on Quest as we bring you even more ways to have fun on the water. Whether you are sticking a toe in the water for the first time or are a seasoned watersports enthusiast, Quest can help make your waterborne adventures the best they can be.

Meet our team, tour our facility or get in touch.
